s: Dine netilat yadayim lasseuda, ubo y"t seipim: kol haokel pat shemmebarekin alayv "hammotzi" — tzarik littol yadayv techilla, ap al pi sheenan meluklakot veeno yodea lahem tuma, lepi shessetam yadayim shehissiach mehem dato mishshemiratan hen sheniyyot letuma, uposelot et hatteruma middibre soperim, ad sheyyirchatzem bammayim kehilkatan. Vetiqqenu ap baakilat chullin mishshum serek teruma, sheyyargilu littol yedehem bekol akila velo yishkechu littol litruma, velo ratzu lechalleq ben kohanim leyisreelim sheen okelim teruma. Vegam akshav sheen hakkohanim okelin teruma mippene hattuma — lo botla taqqana zo, kede sheyyihyu regilim bene yisrael kesheyyibbaneh bet hammiqdash bimhera beyamenu leekol betohora. Velo tiqnu ella bepat, lepi sherob hatterumot hen bepat, shemmin hattora en teruma noheget ella bedagan tirosh veyitzhar, shenneemar "reshit deganeka tirosheka veyitzhareka vego'", vehaddagan, shehu h' mine tebua, derek akilato hu laasot mimmennu pat, vetirosh veyitzhar, hem yayin vashemen, derek shetiyyatan hem bikli, veen adam asuy ligga bahem beyadayv, lepikak, lo hitzriku bahem netilat yadayim apillu bitruma, veen tzarik lomar bechullin. Vegam bepat chullin lo hitzriku ella bepat shergilin bah tadir liqboa seuda alehem, abal pat habbaa bekisanin velachmaniyyot daqqot sheen mebarekin alehem "hammotzi", lepi sheen regilin liqboa seuda alehem, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman qs"ch — en tzerikim netilat yadayim, kemo sheen tzerikim ledagan qodem shennaasa pat, ap al pi shetterumato hi min hattora, ella sheenah regila umetzuya kol kak babbayit, lepikak lo gazeru bishbilah bechullin. Umikkol maqom, im qaba seudato al pat habbaa bekisanin velachmaniyyot daqqot, keshem shemmoelet qebiut zo leinyan "hammotzi" — kak moelet leinyan netilat yadayim, shello lachaloq benehem lepat gemura, kevan sheqqobea alehem kemo al pat gemura, vibarek gam ken birkat "al netilat yadayim":

Apillu pat gemura, im eno okel ella pachot mikkebetza belo qelippatah — yesh lehistappeq im tzarik netilat yadayim, lepi sheppachot mikkebetza eno niqra okel leinyan tumat okalin, shemmippene zeh eno metamme mashqim vookalim acherim shennageu bo, shenneemar "mikkol haokel asher yeakel vego'", vachakamim lo hitzriku netilat yadayim bechullin mishshum serek teruma ella baakila velo bingia, upachot mikkebetza kevan sheeno niqra okel leinyan tuma — en akilato chashuba akila leinyan netilat yadayim. Lepikak, yittol yadayv velo yebarek. Vaapillu okel kol shehu — tzarik netilat yadayim belo beraka. Abal im okel kebetza, apillu mipperurin daqqin — yebarek "al netilat yadayim", sheap sheenan mitztorpin likbetza letumat okalin, mikkol maqom, kevan sheokel umaknis letok meayv shiur hanniqra okel ap leinyan tumat okalin — akilato chashuba akila leinyan netilat yadayim. Abal im ochez chatika gedola sheyyesh bah kebetza veyoter veokel mimmenna pachot mikkebetza — yittol belo beraka, hoil veeno okel keshiur hanniqra okel leinyan tumat okalin:

Ap al pi shehashshoteh en tzarik netilat yadayim, mikkol maqom, im okel dabar shettibbulo bemashqeh, ben shemmetabbelo atta, ben shehaya metubbal miqqodem veokel keshehu metubbal umeluchlach shello nitnaggeb — tzarik littol yadayv techilla, lepi shehammashqim alulim leqabbel tuma yoter, sheen tzerikim heksher. Veod, sheap mashqeh chullin shennageu bo setam yadayim — nitma venaasa rishon letuma, umetamme okalin umashqin acherim bekol shehu, lepikak hechemiru bah yoter mishshum serek teruma, vehitzriku netilat yadayim lekol dabar shemmeluchlach bemashqeh, apillu hu mashqeh sheen bemino teruma kelal, kegon mayim udebash, mishshum serek terumat yayin vashemen. Vaapillu en metabbel ella rosh hayyaraq veen yadayv nogeot bammashqeh kelal, gezera shemma yiggeu bo. Vaapillu leekol al yede kap tzarik netilat yadayim, im mayim metzuyin lepanayv betok mil o d' milin, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman qs"g, gezera shemma yitbelennu beyado kedarko, o yoklennu beyado keshehu metubbal umeluchlach bemashqeh, kevan sheddarko leheakel bayyad. Abal dabar sheddarko leekol al yede kap — lo gazeru shemma yigga bo beyadayv. Ulepikak, ap im naga beyadayv derek miqreh betok hakkap — en tzarik netilat yadayim, kemo sheen tzarik lishtiyyat mashqin, lepi sheen darkam ligga bahem betok hakkos, velaken ap im ba ligga bahem betok hakkos — en tzarik netilat yadayim. Velo od, ella apillu hashshoteh mayim beyado min hannahar, veken hattobel etzbao beshemen o debash ushear mashqin umotzetz achar kak — en tzarik netilat yadayim, lepi shello tiqqenu kelal netilat yadayim lemashqin ella al yede tibbul okalin, velo beinyan acher, hoil veiqqar derek shetiyyat hammashqim hu bikli. Umikkol maqom, bidbash ab verauy laakila, shergilim lipamim leekol mimmennu bayyad belo keli (ella shehu topeach al menat lehatpiach, sheqqaruy mashqeh ledibre hakkol, kemo sheyyitbaer) — yesh lehachamir shello liqqach mimmennu beetzba leekol belo netilat yadayim, ki yesh lomar: meachar shettiqqenu chakamim netilat yadayim lookalin shettibbulan bemashqeh — kol shekken lammashqim atzman im okelam beyado bederek akila, velo hotziu mikkelal taqqana zo ella hashshoteh beyado o bikli leolam. Ubimdinot ellu lo nahagu rob hamon am littol yedehem lekol dabar shettibbulam bemashqeh. Veyesh shellimmedu alehem zekut lomar, shessameku al daat miqtzat harishonim sheameru, shello hitzriku chakamim netilat yadayim ledabar shettibbulo bemashqeh ella bimehem shehayu okelin betohora, mah sheen ken akshav shekkullanu temee metim. Veen limchot beyadam, meachar sheyyesh lahem al mi sheyyismoku, abal haiqqar kassebara harishona. Umikkol maqom, lo yebarek "al netilat yadayim", shessepeq berakot lehaqel:

En niqra mashqeh bilshon hattora ella z' mashqim, shehem: hammayim, vehayyayin, vehashshemen, vehechalab, vehattal, udebash deborim, vedam behema chayya vaop, ukegon shemmetabbel bo lirpua lepiqquach nepesh. Abal dam dagim eno niqra mashqeh, vehaokel dag im damo — en tzarik netilat yadayim:

Veken shear kol me perot, apillu bemaqom shergilin laasot mashqim lishtiyya missechitat ezeh perot, shehu chashub kemashqeh leinyan shabbat — eno niqra mashqeh leinyan tuma, veken leinyan netilat yadayim shettiqqenu mishshum serek teruma leoklah betohora:

Apillu perot hakkebushim o sheluqim umebushshalim beechad miz' mashqim ellu shessachat hammashqeh shennibla bahem — en al hannischat zeh torat mashqeh ella torat okel, meachar shehaya balua baokel, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman sh"k. Veken bebasar vedagim ushear mine okalim hakkebushim o sheluqim beechad miz' mine mashqim ellu. Umikkol maqom, leekol haokel zeh hakkabush o hashshaluq umebushshal beod sheharoteb vehammaraq topeach alayv shello nitnaggeb ad shello yehe bo topeach al menat lehatpiach — tzarik netilat yadayim, shehare okel zeh metubbal bemashqeh, shehammaraq shel hakkebushim o hashsheluqim umebushshalim — mashqeh gamur hu keshehu miz' mashqim, raq mah shennibla mimmennu betok haokel bilbad yatza mittorat mashqeh velo mah shettopeach al gabbayv, ap al pi shennechshab keokel leinyan beraka, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman r"y, velaken yenaggeb oto techilla mimmashqeh sheal gabbayv. Veap shechozer umitlachleach mimmashqeh hannischat mittoko keshennotelo beyado — en bekak kelum. O yoklennu al yede kap, im hu dabar sheddarko leekol al yede kap:

Kol mashqeh shenniqpa veniqrash ad sheen bo topeach al menat lehatpiach — yatza mittorat mashqeh, ben shenniqrash al yede bishshul ben al yede tzinna. Velaken en tzarik littol yadayv lemirqachat meruqqachat heteb ad sheen al gabbah debash topeach al menat lehatpiach. Veyesh omerim shehaddebash eno yotze mittorat mashqeh leolam, apillu niqpa veniqrash legamre veen bo mashqeh topeach kelal. Veyesh lachosh ledibrehem. Umikkol maqom im en mayim metzuyim beqal lepanayv — yukal leekol bekap o besakkin ap im derek mirqachat zo leheakel bayyad, sheen lehachamir kol kak bazeh veligzor shemma yigga, meachar sheyyesh mattirin ligga. Abal im yesh al hammirqachat debash topeach al menat lehatpiach — en lehaqel kelal al yede kap vesakkin. Ak im bitchillat yetziat haddebash mehashshaava, dehaynu kesherisseq hachallot shel debash kede lehotzi haddebash mehem, chishsheb alayv lookalin bilbad velo lemashqin, dehaynu shechishsheb kede laasot mimmennu mirqachat vekayyotze bah, o litteno letok hattabshil, o leareb bo okalin acherim uleoklo immahem bederek akila velo lishtoto kelal — naasa okel al yede machashaba zo, velo yorda alayv torat mashqeh kelal. Veyesh choleqin bazeh. Velaken yesh lehaqel gam bazeh al yede kap o sakkin:

Vekol zeh bemirqachat shehaddebash nikkar bipne atzmo betokah o al gabbah, abal im eno omed bipne atzmo kelal belo taarobet okel, kegon shennimcha haokel hamruqqach legamre venaasa gup echad mammash im haddebash, beinyan sheen bemirqachat zo debash topeach al menat lehatpiach nikkar bipne atzmo beli taarobet okel hannimmoach — nitbattel haddebash mittorat mashqeh legamre venaasa okel, ap al pi shehu topeach al menat lehatpiach, meachar shennaasa gup echad mammash im haokel haomed laakila verauy laakila, dehaynu shehammirqachat aba qetzat, sheen derek bene adam legomah velibloa bebat achat beli hippuk ballashon kelal, shezzo derek shetiyya hi, ella darkah lehapekah meat ballashon ad shettaggia lebet habbelia, shezzo hi derek akila, kegon tappuchim vegudgedaniyyot (sheqqorin plvmy"n vqrshy"n bilshon ashkenaz) merussaqim umeruqqachim heteb bidbash venaasu chatikot abot. (Veim hi rakka kol kak shedderek bene adam legomah velibloa beli hippuk ballashon — kol shekken sheen tzarik netilat yadayim, kemo sheen tzarik lishtiyya apillu shoteh beyado, kemo shennitbaer lemala. Ak im metabbel bah ezeh okel — tzarik netilat yadayim kimtabbel bemashqeh gamur, meachar shehi rakka kol kak, ap al pi shehaokel hammachuy nikkar bah. Vehu shehaddebash hu harob, kemo sheyyitbaer):

Kol mashqeh ap al pi shenniqrash legamre, im chozer venimmoach — chozer lihyot torat mashqeh alayv al hannimmoach. Velaken issa hamtuggenet bechema — tzarik littol yadayv techilla, shehachema hi chalab sheqqarush vechazar venimmoach. Abal hamtuggenet beshumman — en tzarik netilat yadayim, shehashshumman eno miz' mashqin. Veken mirqachat bidbash temarim o debash haqqanim (sheqqorin tzoqar). Vaapillu letiggun bechema en tzarik netilat yadayim ella bimqomot shemmattikin hachema lebaddah techilla bikli echad veachar kak mesimin otah letok hattiggun keshehi mehutteket venimmocha, shekkebar yarad alehem torat mashqeh qodem shennittena letok haokel shehu hattiggun. Abal bimqomot shennotenin letok hattiggun chema qerusha sheen bah topeach al menat lehatpiach — en tzarik netilat yadayim letiggun zeh, shekkevan shehachema qerusha hayeta okel gamur, ukeshehitchila lihyot nimmocha velatzet mimmenna mashqeh — hare yatza letok haokel shehu min hattiggun. Vekol mashqeh habba laokel mittechillat yetziato — en alayv torat mashqeh kelal ella torat okel, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman sh"k:

Mohal hayyotze mibbesar tzali — eno niqra mashqeh. Vaapillu hudach habbasar bemayim qodem hatztzeliyya, mikkol maqom, bishat hatztzeliyya nityabbesh oto lachluchit, umin habbasar yotze mohal, vehu millachluchit habbasar atzmo, veeno niqra mashqeh:

Hannotel yadayv leperot negubim, apillu lechittim useorim shetterumatan min hattora — hare zeh miggasse haruach. Veap al pi shetztzarik lebarek — setam yadayim kesherot libraka, ella im ken yodea shennaga bemaqom metunnap. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshennotel betorat chiyyub netilat yadayim kederek netila lepat, abal im notel derek neqiyyut, sherotzeh lehachamir al atzmo lenaqqot yadayv likbod habberaka, ap al pi sheeno yodea lahem shum tuma — muttar:
Hashshoteh en tzarik littol apillu yado achat, ella im ken shoteh betok hasseuda veen yadayv neqiyyot, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman q"a:

Natal yadayv ledabar shettibbulo bemashqeh veachar kak nimlak leekol lechem — yachazor veyittol yadayv belo beraka im lo hissiach dato, lepi shellehaomerim sheddabar shettibbulo bemashqeh en tzarik netilat yadayim kelal bazzeman hazzeh — hare zeh keillu notel linqiyyut bealma velo leshem mitzvat netila, unetilat yadayim tzerika kavvana leshem netila hammaksheret laakila. Veen tzarik lomar im natal yadayv shello leekol ella mishshum neqiyyut, shehayu yadayv meluklakot, veachar kak nimlak leekol, shetztzarik lachazor velittol yadayv. Umikkol maqom, lo yebarek im lo hissiach dato mehem, lepi sheyyesh omerim shennetilat yadayim enah tzerika kavvana, usepeq berakot lehaqel, ki shemma olta lo netila harishona, veal netila harishona lo shayyak lebarek, kevan shello nitkavven kelal lintila. Lemah haddabar domeh? Lenidda shennopla lammayim venithara mittumatah, sheenah mebareket al tebila zo baaliyyatah:

Mi shehu bammidbar o bimqom sakkana veen lo mayim umepached lachazor acharehem — patur minnetilat yadayim (veen tzarik limnoa milleekol, ap al pi shello yistakken betaanito ad sheyyabiu lo mayim, o sheyyesh lo leekol debarim acherim sheenam tzerikim netilat yadayim, lepi shebbimqom sakkana lo gazeru kelal al netilat yadayim]. Veken keshehayu yotzeim bammachaneh lemilchama — hayu peturim minnetilat yadayim):

Tzarik lizzaher meod bintilat yadayim, shekkol hamzalzel bintilat yadayim — chayyab nidduy, uba lide aniyyut, veneeqar min haolam. Vaapillu hannotel yadayv birbiit metzumtzam mebio lide aniyyut, ella yosip littol yadayv beshepa. Vekol hannotel melo chopnayv mayim — notenim lo melo chopnayv toba uberaka. Umikkol maqom, lo yekavven lekak kede lehitashsher, shennimtza obed al menat leqabbel peras, ella yaaseh likbod qono:

Ap al pi shehannetila hi middibre soperim — mebarekin aleha "asher qiddeshanu bemitzvotayv vetzivvanu al netilat yadayim". Vehekan tzivvanu? Shenneemar "lo tasur min haddabar asher yaggidu leka yamin usemol". Ulepikak, kesheanu shomeim ledibre chakamim — anu meqayyemim mitzvat Hashem shetztzivvanu lishmoa alehem. Vezehu taam kol habberakot shemmebarekin al mitzvot shel dibrehem. Umin haddin haya rauy lebarek qodem hannetila, shekkol hammitzvot mebarekin alehem ober laasiyyatan, ella shellipamim en yadayv neqiyyot, kegon hayyotze mibbet hakkisse, lekak mebarekin leolam achar hannetila, shello lechalleq ben netila lintila. Veod, sheggam hanniggub hu min hammitzva, kemo sheyyitbaer. Veap al pi shellipamim en tzarik niggub — lo ratzu lechalleq ben netila lintila. Umikkol maqom, mi shennotel yadayv beb' shetipot — rauy lo lebarek achar shetipa harishona qodem sheyyitten alehem mayim sheniyyim, shekkebar yadayv hen neqiyyot ureuyot libraka ap im haya bebet hakkisse. Veim shakach velo berak ad achar hanniggub — yebarek achar kak. Veap al pi shekkol hammitzvot shello berak alehen ober laasiyyatan eno mebarek alehen leachar gemar asiyyatan, mikkol maqom, mitzva zo kevan shellipamim i epshar lebarek aleha qodem asiyyatah, kegon hayyotze mibbet hakkisse, umukrach lebarek achar asiyyatah — en lechalleq bah ben paam lepaam, uleolam yakol lebarek achar kak. Ella shellekattechilla medaqdeqim lebarek qodem hanniggub, hoil vegam hu min hammitzva, abal iqqar hannetila shemmebarekim aleha hi hannetila lebaddah shekkebar naaset. Umikkol maqom, im nizkar achar shebberak "hammotzi" — shub eno mebarek "al netilat yadayim". (Vehu haddin im hutzrak littol yadayv beemtza seuda, ledibre haomerim shetztzarik lebarek "al netilat yadayim" veshakach velo berak ad sheakal pat — eno mebarek od, shekkevan shehannetila enah ella biglal haakila, kol shehitchil leekol — shub lo shayyak lebarek al hannetila, shekkebar cholpa veobra. Velo od, ella apillu lo hitchil leekol — lo shayyak lebarek ella miyyad achar hannetila, velo muplag mimmenna. Velaken yesh oserim lehapsiq bedibbur ben netila libraka, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman qs"h. Veim hiplig apillu bishtiqa — shub eno mebarek, sheap shello haya yakol lebarek ober laasiyyatah umukrach lebarek achar kak — en sebara kelal sheyyukal lebarek aleha leolam, ella miyyad achar asiyyatah):

Kol haokel belo niggub yadayim — keillu okel lechem tame, shenneemar "kaka yoklu bene yisrael et lachmam tame baggoyim", al tiqre "lachmam", ella "lach mayim". Veod, "lachmam tame" begimatriyya "belo niggub yadayim". Yesh meporshim shettuma zo hi mimmayim harishonim shennitmeu mehayyadayim im en bahem rebiit. Veap shemmayim hashsheniyyim metaharin et harishonim, mikkol maqom, lekattechilla tzarik lehaabir et harishonim legamre al yede niggub, velo day sheyyitnaggebu mealehen, ella tzarik leshapshepan bemappa o bishar debarim, shehashshipshup metaharan beyoter. Abal hammatbil yadayv, veken hannotel shette yadayv bebat achat veshopek alehem rebiit bebat achat, veken im shapak al yado achat rebiit veken shapak al chabertah, sheen sham mayim temeim kelal — en tzarik lenaggeban. Umikkol maqom, yesh bo mishshum mius im dato qatza alayv. Veyesh meporshim shettumatan hi meisatan, sheddabar maus qaruy tame, kemo sheamar hakkatub: "lachmam tame vego'". Vehu haddin im shapak rebiit bebat achat. Velo heqellu ella bematbil, lepi shello chashu chakamim letaqqen niggub letaher hayyadayim mimmeisutan ella keshemmetaharan betohora shettiqqenu chakamim, shehi netila bikli, abal keshemmetaharan bitbila, shehi keen tohora shel tora, shehi tebila — lo chashu letaqqen bah kelum. Veyesh lehachamir kedibrehem:
Al yenaggeb yadayv bachaluqo, mippene sheqqasheh leshikcha:
Keshehu notel yadayv — notel yamin techilla, veachar kak yad semol. Veken bekol paam sherochetz yadayv — rochetz shel yamin techilla, kemo shennitbaer besiman b':
